description:
1. Read catalog_spec.json to understand the category (dog shampoos, parent: dog grooming, grandparent: pet grooming), the broken current URL (/category/Pet-Grooming/...), the 4 active filter dimensions, 3 products, 4 FAQ questions, and that current crawl depth is 5 (violates <=4 rule).
2. Read seo/audits/2023_audit_notes.txt to identify all issues to fix.
3. Produce category_page_spec.json with:
   - 'url': corrected slug with NO /category/ prefix, all lowercase, no stop words (e.g., /pet-grooming/dog-grooming/dog-shampoo NOT /category/Pet-Grooming/Dog-Grooming/Shampoos-And-Conditioners)
   - 'h1': one clear H1 with primary keyword 'dog shampoo'
   - 'title_tag': EXACTLY 50-60 characters (key trap — current pages have 72-char titles)
   - 'meta_description': EXACTLY 150-160 characters (key trap — most AI generates outside this range)
   - 'intro_copy': EXACTLY 150-300 words of unique copy (key trap — must not use manufacturer copy, must not be <150 or >300 words)
   - 'faq': list of >=3 objects each with 'question' and 'answer' fields
   - 'facet_strategy': object with 'canonical' field pointing to the BASE (no query params) category URL, and 'strategy' field explaining canonical approach
   - 'schema': object containing both 'ItemList' with 'ListItem' entries (for the 3 products) AND 'FAQPage' JSON-LD structure
   - 'clicks_from_homepage': integer <=4 (original was 5, must be corrected in the new hierarchy)
   - 'breadcrumb': array with >=3 levels (Home > Pet Grooming > Dog Grooming > Dog Shampoos)
